sources.wrist: User corrected the observed Q1 wrist direction on 2026-07-31: positive planned rotation is counter-clockwise and negative is clockwise. The mapping sign is inverted so the NexArm command follows that observed convention.
sources.heights: User set pick_height/release_height to -15 on 2026-07-31 from physical measurement. This does not by itself verify magnetic pickup or final placement accuracy.
sources.transfer: Fixed BUFFER XYZ/Pitch/Claw [175,0,80,-90,*,0,3000]: before each pick BUFFER uses that piece's pick roll; after pickup BUFFER uses that piece's release roll, so wrist rotation completes during the lift/transfer before descending to release. After the final release the arm returns directly to HOME.
sources.magnet: STM32 USART1 application uses 115200 8N1 commands and a 50..500 ms timed MAGNET_ON lease. The by-id path ending 5B7A030191 is user-provided deployment data and must be rechecked on Jetson. Production sequence is pick-duration-plus-settle -> MAGNET_ON/status-confirm -> release-duration-plus-settle -> MAGNET_OFF/status-confirm. physical_pick_verified remains false until post-move visual evidence.
sources.motion: The first controller write after opening is the direct HOME set_pose command; Q1 does not send CMD_SET_GLOBAL_ACC. Current Cartesian and joint feedback have both failed to provide a usable production arrival signal on this arm. The sequence therefore uses each controller duration followed by a fixed 1.0 second mechanical settle before continuing. HOME and BUFFER use 3000 ms plus settle; pick and release use 6000 ms plus settle. No feedback wait or movement timeout can block camera initialization or the move queue. K230 initialization performs protocol handshakes without a discarded warmup capture; the next and only capture is the image used for scene analysis and planning.
sources.target_geometry: The official Figure 2 template remains 100x60 mm. Run 20260731_012300_357937 measured the four fixed source polygons at 6375.18 mm2 versus the nominal 6000 mm2, giving a 1.0308 linear ratio. Q1 uses target_scale=1.03 for this physical four-piece set. The scaled 103x61.8 mm target is centered in the A4 lower/right half with origin [53.5,191.85] mm.

_note: Single active source for NexArm, camera and STM32 magnet endpoints, arm calibration, HOME, motion and planning parameters. Production Q1 is STM32-only; real energization still requires --confirm RUN_Q1. The main sequence uses controller duration plus a fixed mechanical settle before switching the magnet.
